rust_summary: the screen_init_post screen lifecycle observation (`native_screen_init_post`) at most once per frame.
doc_summary: `native_screen_init_post` receives a NativeScreenView, observed at most once per frame, including sign, book, dialog and prompt overlays; cancelling an opening is not possible because transitions do not share a single choke point. Bundles need hooks version @API:screen_init_post@.
